name: bench-bare
description: Neutral bare React Native app for benchmarking Re.Pack against plain Metro

scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/repack/main.jsbundle
scripts.bundle:ios:metro: BENCH_BUNDLER=metro react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/metro/main.jsbundle --assets-dest build/metro
